input: Write a cover letter for a grant application

gold.taskTitle: Write a Cover Letter for a Grant Application
gold.taskDescription: Write a compelling cover letter to accompany a grant application for a specific project or cause.

questions.title: What is the grant funding meant to support?
questions.description: Understand the specific project, initiative, or cause the grant money would fund.

questions.title: Which organization or foundation is offering this grant?
questions.description: Identify the specific grant provider so the letter can be tailored to their mission and priorities.

questions.title: Who is the applicant — you, a nonprofit, or a business?
questions.description: Clarify who the applying entity is, as this shapes the tone, voice, and credentials mentioned.

questions.title: What is the total amount of funding you are requesting?
questions.description: Know the dollar amount being requested so it can be referenced appropriately in the letter.

questions.title: Is there a submission deadline you are working toward?
questions.description: Determine the timeline to prioritize urgency and plan drafting and review steps.

questions.title: What specific credentials or past work should be highlighted?
questions.description: Gather key qualifications, achievements, or prior projects that strengthen the application.

questions.title: Does the grant have a required word count or format?
questions.description: Identify any formatting rules, length limits, or structural requirements set by the grantor.
